## path

- `comet-trail` (shader) A bright comet head on the pointer with a glowing tail that tapers and fades through where it has just been, shading from head to tail colour. Takes path. Answers hover, trail. Overlay. Presets: Fireball, Ice, Laser. Tags: trail, interactive, hover, cursor, overlay, glow, comet, path.
- `ribbon-trail` (shader) A shiny two-tone ribbon flowing smoothly after the pointer, twisting over to show its other side as it goes. Takes path. Answers hover, trail. Overlay. Presets: Gold and silver, Silk. Tags: trail, interactive, hover, cursor, overlay, ribbon, spline, path.
- `sparkle-trail` (shader) Twinkling sparkles and four-point stars shed along the pointer's path, each drifting down a little as it fades out. Takes path. Answers hover, trail. Overlay. Presets: Fairy dust, Gold glitter. Tags: trail, interactive, hover, cursor, overlay, sparkle, magic, particles, path.
- `brush-trail` (shader) An ink brush stroke following the pointer, bristle-streaked and breaking up dry at its tail, thinner where it moves faster. Takes path. Answers hover, trail. Overlay. Presets: Red paint, Sumi-e, Chalk on nothing. Tags: trail, interactive, hover, cursor, overlay, brush, ink, paint, path.
- `ghost-trail` (shader) Afterimages of a circle, ring or star stamped along the pointer's path, each fainter, smaller and shifted in hue than the one before. Takes path. Answers hover, trail. Overlay. Presets: Bubbles, Starry. Tags: trail, interactive, hover, cursor, overlay, afterimage, echo, path.
- `light-painting` (shader) Long-exposure light painting in the dark: the pointer leaves neon tubes with white-hot cores that cycle through colour along the stroke and fade slowly. Takes path. Answers hover, trail. Presets: Sparkler writing, Neon tubes. Tags: trail, interactive, hover, cursor, neon, glow, long-exposure, light, path.
- `border-beam` (shader) A bright beam of light travelling round a card's rounded border, or along any path (a logo's outline, a route), trailing a gradient tail. Takes path. Overlay. Presets: Dark, Light, Twin beams, Button. Tags: ui, border, card, button, frame, overlay, glow, saas, path.
- `glass-tube` (shader) A thick, see-through tube of glowing glass drawing itself along any path, with bright edges, a soft core and overlaps that show through each other, coloured from one end to the other. Takes path. Presets: Neon, Chrome, Light, Static. Tags: background, path, line, draw, tube, glass, glow, squiggle, ribbon, wallpaper.
- `glass-writing` (shader) Words written on in one glowing glass stroke, letter by letter as a pen would, in joined-up script or print; give the path words as {"text": …} or any path. Takes path. Presets: Neon sign, Print, Gold. Tags: title, path, handwriting, signature, writing, draw, tube, glass, glow, neon.
- `swoosh-underline` (shader) A glowing curved stroke sweeping on under a subtitle with a bright head and a thinner second stroke chasing it, then wiping away from its tail, along its own curve or any path; a transparent overlay. Takes path. Overlay. Presets: Cream, Hot pink, Gold, Straight. Tags: overlay, promo, underline, swoosh, title, accent, neon, path.
- `route` (vector) A journey drawing itself between two pins along any path, with a traveller following it. Takes path. Tags: map, travel, delivery, journey, path.
- `signature` (vector) A handwritten flourish drawing itself as if by pen, then underlined; give it any path, or words to write as {"text": …}. Takes path. Tags: handwriting, draw-on, personal, reveal, path.
- `text-on-path` (vector) Words gliding along a curve, in at its start and out at its end; give it any SVG path to follow. Takes text, path. Words go in `text`. Presets: Wave, Ink. Tags: text, path, curve, type, title, motion, marquee.
